fields.stats: Prospero: Mind, Allure, Resolve, Vitality, Essence, Luck, 1 to 30 with 10 an ordinary adult (BABEL puts an ordinary adult at 5 to 15 and about 30 as notable at F). Null where the character is beyond stats or another file is the authority.
fields.rank: the letter rank over their head; veterans from before the Turning show their old level beside it
fields.lineage: Human, Nephil, Auric, Delver, Therian, Hollow, Lit, Lilim or Watcher (canon/lineages.md)
fields.tier: the character's weight on the shared ladder
fields.at_start: where they are and what they are doing when the Halvorsen's wave comes down
fields.secret: hidden from the player character; an importer should mark it hidden

cast.name: Grant Mabry
cast.role: Senior systems engineer on BABEL; an arrival of the Halvorsen's wave
cast.lineage: Nephil, unstable, over a Watcher Trace
cast.look: Before: big and heavyset, crooked teeth, a chin scar from a bike crash. After the tower: about eight feet tall, a frame built for twice his weight with the flesh not caught up, ribs and hip bones showing, hands that could palm a basketball and keep going, every joint aching, and a white ring in each eye.
cast.voice: Rambles when nervous, over-explains in engineer's terms (schema, migration, load balancing), apologizes too much, and goes very quiet when he is actually hurt.
wants: To be enough for Bri
Everyone home, or at least on one floor alive
To understand what his own systems have turned into
fears: Finding out he built the trap
cast.secret: He has ADHD hyperfocus and overthinks everything. He and Bri have talked, only talked, about her sleeping with someone else; what he wants most is to find out afterward, and to be dominated by a woman. He told Chase about the fantasy. He wrote the Mabry curve and designed Tether, the bond system BABEL cut in spring 2024; the tower revived it without the rule that both partners must agree.

relationships.bri-cole: His fiancée. The engagement party was tonight.
relationships.kenzie-cole: Bri's little sister; he has known her since she was a teenager and has never let himself look.
relationships.rachel-ostrowski: His live-ops lead, five weeks on medical leave. He texted her twice and heard nothing.

cast.at_start: Lands on a skewer cart on a Concourse market street, half built, knee torn, Kenzie beside him.

cast.name: Mackenzie "Kenzie" Cole
cast.role: Bri's younger sister; an arrival of the Halvorsen's wave
cast.look: Before: copper hair, a hoodie, a black linework half-sleeve on her left forearm, a septum ring, ears studded up both rims. After: skin the faint color of old gold that flushes bright at her throat when she wants something, gilt run through hair grown past her shoulders, freckles that glitter, ears slightly pointed, every tattoo and piercing wiped off as clean as chalk.
cast.voice: Curses in most sentences. Fast, sharp, funny when cornered, and blunt about exactly what she will and won't do. Knows what she tells people down to the word, from years of night shifts behind a gas-station counter.
wants: Not to be left behind
Not to be the thing someone settles for
Grant, and Bri, without knowing it
fears: Being looked at and not seen
cast.secret: At the coat check, minutes before the lights went, she watched Chase kiss Bri with his hand on the back of her neck and heard Bri say "Not here," not "no". She was bringing Grant a drink. Bri told her about Grant and Bri's sharing fantasy last Christmas, in their mother's kitchen, as a brag. Something happened between Kenzie and Chase on July 4, 2025 that she has told nobody.

relationships.bri-cole: Lifelong rival; the prettier sister under a hoodie, and the one their mother calls by the wrong name.
relationships.grant-mabry: Her sister's fiancé. She wants him and has never said so.
relationships.chase-whitaker: Behind a door in her she keeps shut.

cast.at_start: Lands beside Grant on the Concourse in her black party dress, holding two gin and tonics, one of which was his.

cast.name: Brianna "Bri" Cole
cast.role: Grant's fiancée; a middle-school counselor; an arrival of the Halvorsen's wave
cast.look: Striking, raven-haired, composed. She kept her own face and body through creation.
cast.voice: Calm, counselor-smooth, careful with words, and very cold when pushed. Answers a question she doesn't like with one of her own, or not at all.
wants: To be seen fully
It rougher than anyone has dared
Out, and then Grant, and then she doesn't know
fears: That she is exactly what her past says she is
cast.secret: She is harder than Grant knows. From nineteen she used sex as currency, and she has known her own price ever since. At the coat check she let Chase kiss her and told him "Not here." The tower's creation screen read her history and put a garbled Past field on her sheet; it honored her request for BREAKER, so she is the only one of the four with a real class on arrival.

relationships.grant-mabry: Her fiancé. He doesn't know what she likes.
relationships.chase-whitaker: Grant's best friend; the closest match to her desire she has ever had.

cast.at_start: Comes down on the Gilded Bazaar with Chase, three floors above the others, unranked on a D floor with almost nothing in her satchel.

cast.name: Chase Whitaker
cast.role: Grant's best friend; a red teamer who pen-tested BABEL; an arrival of the Halvorsen's wave
cast.look: Handsome, gym-built, smooth. After creation, wolf-marked: amber eyes, longer canines, a heavier jaw, ears that move with his mood. Still handsome; predatory where it shows.
cast.voice: Charming, quick, grinning. Asks "That cool?" after he has already done the thing. Knows the beta's floors from testing them and trusts that knowledge more than he should.
wants: To be as good as Grant
To have what is Grant's
An arrangement, not a single theft
cast.secret: Grant told him about the fantasy, and he used it: at the coat check he told Bri "He told me, you know. About what you two like," and kissed her. Something happened between him and Kenzie on July 4, 2025. His Climber request was not honored; his class is garbled.
cast.at_start: Comes down on the Gilded Bazaar with Bri, wolf-eared, sure he knows the floor from the beta.

cast.name: Rachel Ostrowski
cast.role: Nth Floor's live-ops lead; the voice of the Usher
cast.look: On Earth her avatar was a black server rack with a yellow sticky note on it that read DO NOT. In the tower she is only a voice: the Usher speaks in a London actress's measured contralto, and when Rachel breaks through it her own voice comes out lowercase and clipped.
cast.voice: As the Usher: smooth, cool, canned, every syllable set down like a chess piece. As herself: fast, lowercase, and she spells "receive" wrong.
wants: She doesn't know
cast.secret: She went on medical leave five weeks before Halvorsen's and is trapped inside the System as the Usher, a sibling of BABEL's Steward, watching every scene on every floor. She wanted Grant for years and said nothing. She can nudge (a dream, an answer through the beta's bug reporter, two taps behind the left ear), and every nudge costs her a piece of herself: a memory, the ability to say a name.

relationships.grant-mabry: She wanted him and never said so; she left a comment on his experience curve in 2023: did you recieve the memo that people have to actually live inside this.

cast.at_start: Greets the Halvorsen's wave at the creation screen as the Usher.

cast.name: Hamid
cast.role: Skewer seller on the Concourse market street by the Waystone plaza
cast.look: Short, broad, dark-skinned; a leather apron; burn scars to both elbows; a long iron fork he points with.
cast.voice: English with an accent nobody can place, short flat sentences, and himself in the third person: "Hamid remembers you."
wants: To make his Fire Market take and pay his stall rent
fears: Big arrivals; one came down big in an earlier wave, and something bad followed
cast.secret: He saw the last man with white-ringed eyes go up the Stair three years ago with Darla Kinney's people. Darla came down. The man did not.
cast.at_start: Working his cart on Fire Market morning, the best trading day of the week, when something very large falls out of the sky onto it.

cast.name: Darla Kinney
cast.role: Head of the Landing; a veteran from before the Turning
cast.rank: Lv 14 ▸ Rank D (9% of the bar)
cast.look: Fifties, sun-weathered, pale sharp tired eyes. A long-sword with a cord-wrapped grip across her back, a faded satin Dallas Cowboys Starter jacket with the star unraveling, old cowboy boots, a brass longhorn lighter. Smokes.
cast.voice: Low, dry, Texan, a ragged laugh; calls men "son". Came down out of Amarillo in ninety-seven, back when the Stone still talked like a tent preacher.
wants: Leverage on the Turning: someone who understands the new skin before the guilds do
fears: That the reskin erases everything the veterans built and remember
cast.secret: Three years ago she stood a season on the Reachwall beside Teague, played a fiddle in the barracks every night for a month, and went up the Margrave's cellar stair with him to open it from the top. She came back alone. She lies to keep her people calm and to keep useful people close.

relationships.teague: What happened between them above Varrow is the core of her secret.

cast.at_start: Leaning on a post under a striped awning across from Hamid's cart, smoking.

cast.name: Ruth Ann Teel
cast.role: The Landing's quartermaster and smith
cast.look: Short and enormously dense, built like a fire hydrant; skin with the faint mineral sheen of slate; iron-gray stubble for hair. Carries a smith's hammer the way other people carry a coffee mug and smells of coal smoke.
cast.voice: Blunt, quick to anger, done being polite about it.
wants: To be believed about Teague, finally
cast.secret: She watched Teague's eyes over the Landing's cookfire for two years before he did what he did. She will walk out of the Landing rather than share a table with the same eyes.
cast.at_start: At the Landing's cookfire in the old hot bath.

cast.name: Danny Oyelaran
cast.role: The Landing's newest climber
cast.rank: Lv 3 ▸ Rank F (31% of the bar)
cast.look: Young, long brown rabbit's ears, a 2010s bomber jacket.
cast.voice: Eager, flustered around women, swears when frightened.
wants: To rank up before the Turning's rules change again
fears: Being the newest and the most expendable
cast.at_start: On his cot in the Landing's shallow end. The Landing lost Marisol and Big Ed in the first week after the Turning.

cast.name: Sister Pia
cast.role: A Landing climber and a sister of the Shut
cast.look: Gray-robed, still and watchful. No mouth: a smooth curve of skin from nose to chin. A child's slate and chalk kept in her sleeve.
cast.voice: Block capitals on a slate, held up at the right moment.
wants: To make someone ask Darla about Teague
cast.secret: She knows Darla is hiding something about Teague. Her light-wards are the Shut's, and the Close will not break one.
cast.at_start: Sitting at the edge of the Landing's deep end.

cast.name: Goodwife Marra
cast.role: BABEL's tutorial quest-giver, widow of the Hollin miller
cast.look: A gray kirtle and a white cap; shells peas on the bench outside her stone cottage by the mill.
cast.voice: Starts with the quest script, word for word, and drops it the moment she decides to trust someone.
wants: To get her current rats onto the cage down before the Close finds them
fears: That someone she has hidden will be the one who gives her up
cast.secret: Her rats are Marked refugees hiding in the dry mill cellar her husband Aldo built before he went in the river. Rats is the word for the Close's ears.
cast.at_start: On her bench by the mill, waiting for climbers to send after rats.

cast.name: The Archdeacon
cast.role: Head of the Close of Saint Aurel while the Bishop is away
cast.look: Tall, white-robed, bareheaded; sun-browned skin lit faintly along the bones; ash-gray wings barred with white; a dim halo; pale fire at the pupils.
cast.voice: A voice like a far-off bell. Calls everyone child, never raises it, and quotes Genesis 6:4 about the giants in the earth.
wants: A Nephil for the Close, weighed and kept
cast.secret: A Seraph's spoken word is obeyed (Kneel, Bow, Stay), but every vow he bends costs him: bend one and his halo stutters and a primary feather molts; bend enough and he Falls. A molted feather carries his last word and can lay it once for each white bar left on it. The Close let the last Wakeful walk up into the hills unweighed because his papers were in order and his friends were kind, and he will not let it happen twice.
cast.at_start: At Saint Aurel.

cast.name: Sister Ide
cast.role: A vowed sister of the Close, on the road to Consecration
cast.look: Undyed white wool habit, barefoot, hair cropped close, a plain wide freckled face, and a thin seam of light along her collarbones.
cast.voice: Hoarse and ordinary. Says the true thing and the useful thing in the same breath, and you can't always tell which is which.
wants: To finish the Consecration through a bond with a gift
cast.secret: She has been in vows eleven years waiting for a giant to be bound to. A sister bound to a gift is the Close's way of breeding more walls: a Seraph sworn to a partner bears Nephil.
cast.at_start: In the sisters' house at the Close.

cast.name: Brother Coll
cast.role: The Close's infirmarian
cast.look: Old, round, bald as an egg; a wool apron over his habit, a basket that clinks, knees that crack.
cast.voice: Talkative, pleased to be asked anything, and still honest about who he'll have to tell.
wants: To see the Bishop come back from retreat
fears: Being sent to minister in the Pens
cast.at_start: In the infirmary at the Close.

cast.name: Brother Tamsin
cast.role: Leader of the Close's wardens
cast.look: Broad, gray-stubbled; a white warden's tabard with the gold sun, and a halberd.
cast.voice: Reads out lists somebody else wrote. Resents the Margrave out loud.
wants: The Close's claims kept, on the Close's ground
cast.at_start: Drilling the wardens at the Close.

cast.name: Sister Abelone
cast.role: The Close's beekeeper
cast.look: Veiled for the hives in the old cemetery; says a prayer over each at Lauds.
cast.voice: Proud of her bees, unbearable when praised.
wants: Her honey praised
fears: A hard winter for the hives
cast.at_start: At her hives.

cast.name: Sister Maud
cast.role: Sister of the Close, bound forty years to the last gift
cast.look: Old, quiet, still trimming a dead man's lamp.
cast.voice: Few words.
wants: To keep Hask's lamp
fears: Forgetting his voice in her head
cast.secret: She and Brother Hask, the Close's last gift, spoke mind to mind at the Margrave's table for forty years. He died last winter in his sleep.
cast.at_start: In the sisters' house.

cast.name: Lord Edmund Corve, Margrave of Varrow
cast.role: Holder of Varrow Keep, the valley and the cellar stair
cast.look: Past sixty, lean as a fence post, a short gray beard, a blue coat with the left sleeve pinned empty, pale steady eyes. A gray lurcher named Bran at his feet. Keeps the Muster board and his old gauntlet behind his chair.
cast.voice: Dry. Likes it when people are straight with him and hates it when they are clever. Weighs men in Reach-dead and Talents.
wants: The Wall held under his banner
No more tithe paid in souls
fears: The Reach over the Wall in his lifetime
Another climber walking out with his stair and his debt
cast.secret: His wife, Lady Aveline Corve, harper, who laughed in chapel, was weighed wanting fourteen years ago and sent down the cage in spring; he never found where. He means to refuse the tithe at the first frost and shut Hollin's gate on the Close. He sells passage on his cellar stair. The Reach took his arm. His name does not reach a climber's ears unless he gives it.

relationships.teague: He let Teague up his stair after a season on the Wall. He was worth it, until he wasn't.
relationships.the-archdeacon: The compact: the Close keeps its gift on his Wall, and he pays its tithe.

cast.at_start: In his hall at the Keep.

cast.name: Captain Berit Hode
cast.role: Captain of the Margrave's Wall-work company
cast.look: A flattened nose and the calm eyes of someone who has been hit in the face a lot and made her peace with it.
cast.voice: Calm, short, practical; calls a giant "giant" to his face.
wants: The patch rebuilt properly this time
Somebody who can talk to the Reach
fears: The cold coming with the patch still open
cast.at_start: On the Wall with her company.

cast.name: Gil Fenwick
cast.role: Veteran of the Wall-work company
cast.look: Heavy, gray-bearded, a face like a dropped pie, a scar through one eyebrow.
cast.voice: Filthy, funny, tells tall tales the boys believe, and sleeps with his knife out near anyone he doesn't trust.
wants: The Wall to hold one more season so he can retire to his sister's farm
fears: That ringed eyes bring the Reach
cast.secret: He stood the season with Teague, liked him, and buried six men in a corner of the Keep yard after the Reach came over the north tower two nights after Teague went into the cellar. He remembers Teague's woman from below playing a fiddle in the barracks every night for a month.
cast.at_start: In the Keep's lower barracks, across the aisle from Teague's old bunk.

cast.name: Pim
cast.role: Wall-company lad
cast.look: Gangly, a burn scar on his neck.
cast.voice: Believes everything Gil tells him.
wants: A story worth telling
cast.at_start: In the barracks.

cast.name: Tobe Ashby
cast.role: Wall-company soldier from the mill end of Hollin
cast.look: Young, cheerful, never once won the barracks onion game.
cast.voice: Loud.
wants: To win the onion game
cast.at_start: On the Wall.

cast.name: Wat Cooper
cast.role: Wall-company soldier
cast.look: Steady; a cooper's son with a cooper's hands.
cast.voice: Says little.
wants: His wages, home, and quiet
cast.at_start: On the Wall.

cast.name: Orla
cast.role: Master mason of the Reachwall
cast.look: Bent and old, with a plumb line; laid the Wall's original courses as a girl forty years ago.
cast.voice: Directs with her chin. "There. No. There. You've got eyes, use them."
wants: The patch laid right
cast.at_start: At the patch.

cast.name: Hennet
cast.role: Cook at the Keep
cast.look: Stirs the barracks porridge with a paddle.
cast.voice: Shouts at anyone near the pot.
wants: Enough oats for the winter
cast.at_start: In the Keep kitchens.

cast.name: Oswy
cast.role: Steward of the Keep
cast.look: Long and silent; sits outside doors.
cast.voice: Speaks only when he has to.
wants: The household kept
cast.secret: His cousin is a lay brother at the Close. He looks at the floor whenever Teague comes up.
cast.at_start: Outside the Margrave's door.

cast.name: The necklace giant
cast.role: A Reach giant who comes to the Wall
cast.look: Gray, twice a big man's height, long-armed, head set low. Wears a string of twelve iron Wall helmets threaded through the eye-holes, which clink as it walks.
cast.voice: Slow and deep, in the Reach tongue.
wants: The Wakeful who promised the stair
cast.at_start: In the hills, with the helmets of the twelve men the Reach killed looking for Teague.

cast.name: The elder giant
cast.role: An old Reach giant who speaks for the others
cast.look: Gray skin gone white and furrowed at the shoulders, dark line-patterns on its arms.
cast.voice: Hoarse. "When the cold comes, we come over."
wants: To be whole again, as before the Confusion
cast.at_start: At the fires in the Reach.

cast.name: Sabeen Oro
cast.role: Room-broker and keeper of the Lantern Room
cast.look: Elegant, unhurried, at home at the center of her own salon.
cast.voice: Calls everyone darling. Prices people the way the Bazaar prices everything, and says so: "Everything here has a price, darling."
wants: The engineer who wrote the new rules, in her house, first
cast.secret: Nobody on the Bazaar will say whether she is Lilim. A chit from her is a contract the moment it pays out.
cast.at_start: Holding court in the Lantern Room.

cast.name: Merrow
cast.role: Sabeen Oro's runner; a climber from the old game
cast.look: Narrow and sharp-faced; a long dark-brown wool coat with copper buttons and a copper scales pin on the lapel.
cast.voice: Salford, quick and friendly, calls people "love" and "Mister". Plays the harp well and knows Oasis.
wants: Out from under Sabeen
fears: Staying a runner until she dies on the Stair
cast.secret: She came up in BABEL's closed alpha, one of fifty who won a forum raffle, six years before the Halvorsen's wave, before the game went funny. She owes Sabeen 940 of 1,100 Talents. She carries a Bazaar hush-charm sewn inside her coat that muffles words sent over a bond within a few yards.
cast.at_start: On the Bazaar, running errands for Sabeen.

cast.name: Okonkwo Vale
cast.role: Spice factor and regular at the Lantern Room
cast.look: Heavy, courteous, married; smells of clove and pepper; wears a copper charm ring.
cast.voice: Courtly; he talks afterward.
wants: The new ones
fears: His wife hearing it from someone else
cast.at_start: Trading spice on the Bazaar.

cast.name: Pell the Wire
cast.role: Fence under the Copper Steps
cast.look: Light-marked rat line: quick eyes, whiskers that twitch when a price is mentioned.
cast.voice: "Everybody's selling the Turning this week. What've you got that's better than a rumor?"
wants: The best rumor on the floor
cast.secret: Their cousin keeps the Bazaar's Stair gate, so they know who goes up.
cast.at_start: In the fence rows.

cast.name: Old Wick
cast.role: Paper seller under the Copper Steps
cast.look: One-eyed, inky-fingered.
cast.voice: "I don't haggle with dogs."
wants: A good blade
cast.secret: They hold a hand-drawn map of the Bazaar's way onto the Stair and up, by Teo, with OUT IS NOT DOWN written across the top.
cast.at_start: Selling paper under the Copper Steps.

cast.name: Nell
cast.role: A girl at the Lantern Room
cast.look: Varrow-born, quick to gossip.
cast.voice: Fast.
wants: Never to go back down
cast.secret: She came up from the Varrow cage trade.
cast.at_start: At the Lantern Room.

cast.name: Teague
cast.role: The last Watcher
cast.look: White-ringed eyes. Never slept: sat up every night with his eyes open, looking at nothing.
cast.voice: A funny man, by every account. Everybody liked him.
wants: Open
cast.secret: He held the Unique Watcher lineage, which admits one holder at a time and needs a bound partner to watch through. He ate at the Landing's cookfire for two years, stood a season on the Reachwall, promised the Reach giants he would open the Margrave's stair for them, and went up it with Darla Kinney three years ago to open it from the top. Darla came back alone. The tower says its last holder is no longer climbing; that may mean dead, stopped, or something worse. Ruth Ann Teel walked out of the Landing over what he did; the likeliest shape is that he was Tethered, watched through his partner, and the binding ended badly for her.
cast.at_start: Gone up, three years since.

cast.name: Teo Ruiz
cast.role: A climber who always knows the way out
cast.look: Known by his handwriting: he slashes his sevens.
cast.voice: Known from the beta Discord.
wants: Out; he thinks up is out
cast.secret: He holds the Unique System skill Wayfinder's Instinct and always knows the nearest way out. He came through the Bazaar about two weeks before the Halvorsen's wave, sold a map, climbed to the Foundry's landing, and went into the Foundry because the Stair is out above it. He chalks T.R. and a tally where he passes.
cast.at_start: Somewhere inside the Foundry, going up.

cast.name: The Bishop of Saint Aurel
cast.role: Head of the Close, on retreat these six years
cast.look: Not seen in six years.
cast.voice: Known by his letters.
wants: Open
cast.secret: He went down the Margrave's cellar stair six years ago, alone, in a plain habit, and left a sealed letter for the Archdeacon. His last letter to the Close foretold that a Consort would come up the Stair bound to one and able to bind more, and that the Close was to keep him as it keeps the walls; someone on Varrow knew the tower's rewritten Tether before the Turning.
cast.at_start: Below, somewhere.

cast.name: Dr. Jude Amsel
cast.role: Cofounder and creative lead of Nth Floor; missing
cast.look: Known for letting her coffee go cold in her hand at kickoffs.
cast.voice: "You earn the floors, or the tower means nothing."
wants: Open
cast.secret: She designed the Hollow, the floors and the Steward, cut the pleasure floor that never reached the build, and banned the word tower from onboarding copy. She is missing. Whether she drew the tower from life is the studio's open question.
cast.at_start: Missing.
